recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-15831 unless the Condition SNOMED CT mappings are substantively redesigned in a future tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-15831 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request for STU3 reporting syntax errors in the Condition SNOMED CT ECL mappings where repeated exclusions followed MINUS without a bracketed expression. The approved resolution was to replace the chained MINUS terms with a single bracketed OR expression after MINUS.
initial_application: No current git commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-15831 was found. The current Condition StructureDefinition was introduced by the R4B source rework with the root Condition SNOMED CT concept mapping already in the approved bracketed MINUS form, indicating the STU3/R4-era application was carried forward into the current source.
additional_context: Condition is an active resource in source/fhir.ini, so source/condition/structuredefinition-Condition.xml is a current build input. The second same-family Condition.code SNOMED CT concept-domain expression was corrected later by FHIR-17445 in commit 4d85964ec52, and FHIR-17445 is already represented on the combined branch by audit commit b56728ece3ab. Zulip and Confluence searches for the issue keys and Condition ECL terms found no conflicting community record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source has only two MINUS occurrences in the active Condition mapping file, and both use the corrected bracketed exclusion set rather than the invalid repeated-MINUS form.

related_jiras.note: Corrected the second Condition SNOMED CT ECL mapping expression and is already audited on the combined branch.
